site: raw preMLP4 -> RMS -> full bilinear MLP update
training: H851 original2048 training documents, one of16 captured positions per document chosen by document_index mod16. Fixed Gaussian tangential perturbation at5% raw-state norm per document, independent of learner and task labels.
evaluation: 512 H851 development documents from separate natural-document pool; reused research development, not reserved or fresh test. Independent5% tangent noise plus opposite sign and10% dose. No task directions loaded in fitting or selection.
objectives: native: centered-energy-normalized outputMSE; endpoints: average native+edited endpointMSE at same normalizer; effects: native outputMSE + effectMSE divided by TRAINING effect energy. This deliberately changes weighting, not endpoint information. Same initializations, minibatches, architecture, Adam .003 and final2000step checkpoint.
limits: Compact update surrogate, not activation autoencoder or discovered sparse ontology. Local update scores do not establish outputKL or task preservation. Known rank is NOT assumed here;64 is a fixed compression budget. Full input access and normalization are part of student computation.
